text: 据央视：李强主持召开国务院常务会议，会议决定，对《中华人民共和国档案法实施条例》等14部行政法规的部分条款予以修改，对《中华人民共和国港口间海上旅客运输赔偿责任限额规定》等4部行政法规予以废止。
text_en: According to CCTV: Li Qiang presided over a State Council executive meeting. The meeting decided to amend some provisions of 14 administrative regulations, including the Implementation Regulations of the Archives Law of the People's Republic of China, and to repeal 4 administrative regulations, including the Provisions on Limits of Liability for Maritime Passenger Transport Between Ports of the People's Republic of China.
